# Part VIII: Beyond Tables {.unnumbered}

Not all audit evidence fits in rows and columns. Grievances and inspection notes are free text. Vendors, employees and bank accounts form a web of links. Beneficiaries, clinics and inspections have a place on the map.

This part shows how to analyse each of these. The three groups of chapters stand on their own, so start with whichever your audit needs.
